issues.body:
Maintainer direction — 2026-11-05: consolidate useful intermediate tags on the path to 1.0.0. This issue owns roadmap and release-candidate preparation; it does not publish a tag or package.

The latest observed tag/GitHub Release is [0.4.0](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/releases/tag/0.4.0), published 2026-10-23. Baseline `6e7c934` had 99 commits since that tag. Package-channel contents are a separate observation.

The maintained [roadmap](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/blob/main/devguide/roadmap.md) and [0.5.0 readiness route](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/blob/main/devguide/release_0_5_0_readiness.md) now record this proposed capability-based staircase:

- **0.5.0:** consolidate current native classical workflows, explicit receptor generation including qualified #94, quantity/provenance/error contracts, usable recipes, compatibility and migration/release notes.
- **Further 0.x.y minors:** coherent prioritized molecular-ownership/integration and broader preparation/scientific/retrospective validation batches. The sequence can continue through 0.10.0, 0.11.0 and later minors. Exact versions, counts and dates are not reserved.
- **Stabilization in whichever 0.x.y minor is ready:** agree and freeze the classical 1.0 scope; stabilize public APIs, native records, compatibility/migration and supported installation evidence. This phase is not tied to 0.9.x.
- **1.0.0:** deliver that stable documented classical scope with reproducible scientific cases, disclosed limits and qualified supported source/installed/public delivery. Dynamics, AI and the viewer addon are not automatic prerequisites.

#94 is delivered in source at [3d26b28ae072c106784299ee96d3a50f0edebc91](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/commit/3d26b28ae072c106784299ee96d3a50f0edebc91). Its receipt records 295 unique passing selected controls across preserved scopes, a final 114-case run, the unchanged 12-model/72-primary/24-recovery replay and three executed cookbook blocks. This evidence has a narrow analytical scope and does not certify a full release candidate.

Next preparation:
1. Review the complete 0.4.0-to-candidate capability/API/migration diff and draft version-specific release notes.
2. Choose and record one full committed candidate SHA; verify its applicable source and exact-head hosted #9 gates.
3. Commit a reviewed real 0.5.0 version plan when selecting that candidate. The existing release plan still records 0.4.0 and is unchanged by this planning stage.
4. Complete applicable exact-file build, dependency closure, supported installed matrix and independent public-install gates under #10/#23.
5. State readiness separately for source tag, GitHub Release and package. GitHub Release `released` triggers Conda/docs workflows, so coordinate that event deliberately.
6. On actual new tag/release/package publication, deliver the requested version-specific MolSysSuite notice with immutable source/artifact identity, executed checks and pending deliveries.

Tags must identify reviewed version-consistent commits and evidence. Patch versions repair an existing minor; minor versions consolidate coherent new capabilities. Neither commit count nor locally passing subsets alone determine publication. Preserve historical tags/artifacts and keep provider-owned molecular operations in MolSysMT.

Planning records are delivered; this issue remains open for the concrete 0.5.0 candidate and its readiness decision. No tag, GitHub Release, package, version-plan change or publication workflow has been created here.

Maintainer clarification: 0.9 need not be followed by 1.0. Minor versions are integers, and 0.10.0, 0.11.0 and further pre-1.0 milestones remain available. Only the agreed scope/stability/delivery criteria determine readiness for 1.0.0. Proposed next minor remains 0.5.0.

## Fresh public dependency receiving — 2026-11-05

Delivered in main [25f39fa](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/commit/25f39fa466130adb87d864a5593d032e44106c70); actual receiving source is immutable `9c163654375c5933be6400282105b89376f03578`. [Contract/results](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/blob/25f39fa466130adb87d864a5593d032e44106c70/devguide/public_dependency_receiving.md) and [original receipt](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/blob/25f39fa466130adb87d864a5593d032e44106c70/devguide/evidence/public_dependency_receiving_20261105_summary.json) retain the complete closure, actual archives/imports/native identities, failed attempts, node outcomes and unchanged producer/input evidence.

A new Python 3.14.10/Mamba 2.9.0 environment contains 325 exclusively public uibcdf/conda-forge packages. Only PHMT is editable; installation, pip check and the actual public-context preflight pass. **203 unique selected controls pass, 18 are skipped, zero scientific failures.** Native I/O:82; reference/pose:21; historical feature routes:2; pure cached-profile orchestration:98. The last group does not execute molecular recognition/direction calculation.

Public MolSysMT `0.23.0-pyabi3h03bb3b7_0` lacks the modern `chemical_states` namespace, modern H-bond recognition namespace, generic `structure.get_vectors` and experimental site-direction operation. Twelve modern vector-route and six chemical-domain controls are omitted; skips do not qualify these capabilities. The existing historical donor arithmetic remains bounded #41/#375 debt, with no new molecular fallback. Known old-public pandas topology deprecations remain MolSysMT#431.

**Disposition: partial public compatibility; full proposed-scope public qualification and candidate freeze remain pending.** The concrete relationship with MolSysMT is its supported public delivery of already consumed source contracts, tracked through existing [#255](https://github.com/uibcdf/molsysmt/issues/255)/[#375](https://github.com/uibcdf/molsysmt/issues/375). Receive the identified artifact under a new run identity, then choose a justified public minimum and exact candidate gates. Source fixes are not reopened and no dependency floor is guessed. No provider edits, scientific changes, version-plan change, candidate package, tag, Release or publication. #9/#10/#23 retain their own full exact-source/installed/platform/public gates. Independent PHMT cached-model work can continue.

issues.body:
## What

PharmacophoreMT's molecular-ownership audit (https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/issues/41) needs public MolSysMT geometry for recognized donor–H pairs and, under an explicitly named chemical model, acceptor local directions. Recognition already belongs to `physchem.get_hbond_sites`; coordinate-derived molecular directions must also remain provider-owned.

## Inspected consumer evidence

At PharmacophoreMT `3ed12cd9405c8bbb577afefca58c372b5e0785f1`, `modeler/features.py` delegates recognition to public `get_hbond_sites` but computes and normalizes `coordinates[hydrogen] - coordinates[donor]` locally. `modeler/structure_based.py` additionally recognizes protein SMARTS through RDKit, infers a projection from the first bonded neighbor, and invents `[0,0,1]` when no neighbor exists. The latter is a legacy hypothesis heuristic, not an established lone-pair method.

Local provider inspected: clean `8ae160fc93ed5bc815bcc24b37c2875ba735623d`. Remote structure-module inventory inspected on 2026-10-10 (default branch then `9ea9be32a26f957d7f521a37c3bde5537f028596`) exposes centers, least-squares planes, angles, distances and neighbors, but no public directed atom-pair vector tool. Public hbond-site documentation explicitly excludes geometry. Issue searches for `lone pair` and `direction` found no existing request with this contract. These are source/API observations, not an executed defect reproduction or qualification of remote main.

## Requested provider-owned contract

Please decide and document reusable public operations, composing existing recognition and geometry rather than duplicating molecular kernels:

1. Directed vectors/displacements for explicitly supplied ordered source atom pairs, with explicit structure selection, physical units, stable source indices, finite/zero-length behavior, declared periodic convention and producer/method evidence. A general pair-vector operation should be independently reusable beyond hydrogen bonds.
2. An explicit fixed-state hydrogen-bond geometry operation or composed recipe: donor–H directions from recognized source pairs; acceptor directions only under a documented named chemical/local-geometry model, returning multiplicity and unsupported/ambiguous cases rather than arbitrary axes or first-neighbor guesses. Resolve the selected chemical state coherently with recognition and retain geometry-member correspondence.

No protonation, hydrogen addition, environmental optimization, pocket finding or pharmacophoric projection distances/type complementation should be implicit. PHMT owns deciding where hypothetical complementary ligand sites are placed; MolSysMT owns geometry derived from the molecular system. Source coordinates/chemistry must remain unchanged. Include independent numerical/unit controls, reordered atom pairs, incomplete/unsupported local chemistry, multiple frames and undefined geometry.

## Consumer transition and related work

PHMT will retire the legacy structure-based molecular implementation and consume cached native inventories with explicitly declared hypothesis projections. It will not implement a new molecular direction/lone-pair engine while this proposal is pending. The existing donor-vector calculation is tracked as a bounded outstanding migration under PHMT #41, not accepted as a second permanent geometry tool.

This capability is distinct from #323 (environment-dependent fixed-state H refinement) and #350 (bounded diagnostics for rejected aromatic interaction candidates). Their scientific scopes remain unchanged. Provider maintainers decide the API, chemical model and priority; a delivered donor-pair vector tool alone must not be described as delivering acceptor lone-pair geometry.

## What

Warning-strict MolSysViewer documentation examples fail in hosted CI when public native topology operations emit `Pandas4Warning` for deprecated `inplace` arguments. Three pages fail on Linux/macOS/Windows: selections, measurements and state export. Normal scientific output is not reported as incorrect; the observed failure is in warning-strict execution.

## How

Consumer exact source: MolSysViewer `7449675aa8407e94136357f11da1256188e46183`.

- [Python 3.14 source-pair run 39882740307](https://github.com/uibcdf/molsysviewer/actions/runs/39882740307), all three platform cells fail `tests/test_documentation_pages_run.py::test_the_page_runs_as_written`.
- [Core run 39882740305](https://github.com/uibcdf/molsysviewer/actions/runs/39882740305), six cells fail the same three examples; the two Python 3.11 cells pass.
- The source-pair routine provider reference is the preserved public MolSysMT `46ef28eb60a258aa77d82ff1bc39ee0d1591e3c9` / 0.23.0. This does not claim the current provider main is identically qualified.

First failing block:

```python
import molsysviewer as msv
view = msv.demo['1TCD']
view.active_selection.set('molecule_type=="protein" and group_index<5')
```

The consumer guard runs page blocks with `DeprecationWarning` and `UserWarning` promoted to errors. Exact CI message:

> The inplace keyword in Bonds_DataFrame.sort_values is deprecated and will be removed in a future version (PDEP-8).

Hosted warnings also identify native topology `reset_index` and chemical-state `Series.reset_index`. Local inspection of current MolSysMT `fa2f3aa9232372e5fa7db8bbf4ebd9e2ad481056` still finds `Bonds_DataFrame._sort_bonds` calling `sort_values(..., inplace=True)` and `reset_index(..., inplace=True)`. That is inspected evidence; the current local development environment does not reproduce the newer hosted pandas warning. Exact installed pandas-version receiving and current-main scientific qualification remain to be done by the owner.

## Why

Please repair the owning public operations while preserving scientific topology values, ordering, domain identities and independent output/source ownership across supported pandas versions. No downstream warning filter, skipped example, weakened warning guard or speculative pandas upper bound has been added.

Related but distinct: #386 fixed obsolete `pandas.concat(copy=...)` calls and is closed. This report concerns deprecated `inplace` operations still present in current source; historical copy warnings in the old public baseline do not establish a regression of that fix.

Consumer integration: uibcdf/molsysviewer#264. Rerun `python -m pytest --receptor=ci tests/test_documentation_pages_run.py` in the affected environment after the provider repair, then qualify a new exact source pin separately. No new public package floor or installed-pair qualification follows from this report.

issues.body:
## Observed bounded profile

PharmacophoreMT [#98](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/issues/98), following its fixed-work #97 baseline, profiles the existing cached generator on **two donor/two ring occurrences, 32 returned hypotheses of 64 possible, four sites, no molecular operation**. Actual providers: public **PyUnitWizard 0.29.0 / SMonitor 0.22.1**, Python **3.14.10**, Linux x86_64. One CPU, 1 GiB memory cap, zero swap, nice19/idle I/O, six backend thread limits one; no concurrent own tests/builds.

The instrumented generator call records:
- 22,672 public `is_quantity` invocations: cumulative 6.889 s.
- **17,792 `emit_probe_miss` calls**, code `PUW-DBG-PROBE-001`: cumulative **6.116 s of 9.357 s** profiled generator duration.
- This path reaches 17,792 SMonitor `ensure_configured` calls, 17,792 path resolutions and 213,504 `lstat` calls. The SMonitor provider-path part is separately reported to its owner.

These are nested cumulative times, not additive ownership shares or an uninstrumented speedup estimate. Separate controls take 4.669 / 4.620 s; warmup, profile and both controls have identical complete native model/report/metadata fingerprints, independent geometry/order/coverage, cache/unit-policy preservation and unchanged source/native/provider identities. PHMT scientific runtime remains immutable9c163654375c5933be6400282105b89376f03578; the consumer profile driver is frozen at80efdc520278055ed216279dc324a60df8f729c2. The profile's full receipt will be linked from #98 closeout.

## Provider-only reproduction (executed)

```python
import cProfile
import pstats
import pyunitwizard as puw

assert puw.is_quantity(1) is False  # first-use bootstrap outside the profile
profile = cProfile.Profile()
profile.enable()
answers = [puw.is_quantity(1) for _ in range(100)]
profile.disable()
assert answers == [False] * 100
pstats.Stats(profile).sort_stats("cumulative").print_stats(
    "emit_probe_miss|ensure_configured|realpath|lstat"
)
```

The fresh process imports no PharmacophoreMT or molecular system. All 100 answers are False. It records exactly **100 probe-miss emissions, 100 ensure_configured/path resolutions and 1,200 lstat calls**, after warmup. The executed file/versions and raw pstats are retained. A caller walking ordinary mixed metadata legitimately needs quantity detection; normal negative results currently materialize DEBUG payload/configuration/event work for every leaf.

## Requested outcome / ownership

Please identify a supported low-cost expected-negative probe route or improve this generic boundary. Keep boolean results, string/parser/backend behavior, lazy optional availability, application policy and requested diagnostic/capture guarantees. In particular, avoid eagerly constructing repr/context/event data when the supported observer contract does not require it; retain complete requested diagnostics. The owner should decide the compatible API/implementation and tests; this is not a request to silently suppress all diagnostics or infer quantity types in downstream code.

Inspected current main00d1cd89744e02083dd53e3e1705c5920221fb4c still has the same public `is_quantity(..., parser=None)` emission paths and unconditional [emit_probe_miss](https://github.com/uibcdf/pyunitwizard/blob/00d1cd89744e02083dd53e3e1705c5920221fb4c/pyunitwizard/_private/smonitor/emitter.py). That is source inspection, not a new main/public-artifact qualification. Searches for probe-miss / is_quantity-performance found no existing matching issue.

The concrete relationship with `component:pharmacophoremt` is repeated quantity detection while detaching cached model metadata; `component:smonitor` owns the downstream registration/emission cost. PHMT adds no local quantity detector, unsupported-type blacklist, provider edit, global diagnostic suppression or speculative dependency floor. This is a performance/API proposal with scientifically correct outputs, not a reproduced wrong scientific answer. Provider maintainers retain prioritization/publication ownership.
issues.title: Provide a low-cost expected-negative quantity probe without per-leaf diagnostic materialization

issues.body:
## Observed provider-owned cost

PharmacophoreMT [#98](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/issues/98) profiles a fixed cached-generation workload with public PyUnitWizard 0.29.0/SMonitor 0.22.1, Python 3.14.10/Linux x86_64. One CPU, 1 GiB/no swap, low CPU/idle I/O priority, serial execution. Scientifically identical complete native model/report/metadata and geometry/order/coverage/custody checks pass before accepting the profile.

One instrumented public generator call records **17,792 ensure_configured calls**, all from emit_from_catalog; **17,792 pathlib.resolve/realpath calls and 213,504 lstat calls**. The provider root is the same stable absolute installed PyUnitWizard package directory. ensure_configured contributes 2.454 s cumulative inside 9.357 s of instrumented call time; Path.resolve contributes 1.835 s nested within it. These nested times are not additive shares or uninstrumented speedup estimates. Separate generator controls take 4.669/4.620 s.

The source checks configured-package membership only **after** Path(package_root).resolve(). Every warmed DEBUG probe-miss emission therefore repeats filesystem normalization before the memoized return. PyUnitWizard's repeated negative-probe emission is separately tracked in [PyUnitWizard#141](https://github.com/uibcdf/pyunitwizard/issues/141); this issue isolates SMonitor's generic already-configured registration path.

## SMonitor-only reproduction (executed)

```python
import cProfile
import pstats
from pathlib import Path
import smonitor
from smonitor.integrations import ensure_configured

root = Path(smonitor.__file__).parent
ensure_configured(root)  # first-use outside the profile
profile = cProfile.Profile()
profile.enable()
for _ in range(100):
    ensure_configured(root)
profile.disable()
pstats.Stats(profile).sort_stats("cumulative").print_stats("resolve|realpath|lstat")
```

This fresh process imports neither PyUnitWizard nor PharmacophoreMT, emits no application catalog events and performs no molecular operation. On the actual 0.22.1 prefix it records 100 ensure_configured/path resolutions and 1,200 lstat calls after warmup. The joined public PyUnitWizard reproduction independently records the same 100/1,200 counts. Raw pstats, exact imports/providers and original full consumer outputs will be linked from #98's receipt.

## Requested outcome and compatibility

Please provide or identify a supported low-cost route for repeated already-configured catalog emission. Keep first-use/provider registration, declaration-only versus bootstrap behavior, application configuration authority, explicit forced-provider policy, reset/configuration lifecycle, path semantics and concurrency guarantees. Include relative/cwd/symlink cases where relevant and retain the safeguards from #3. The owner should choose a compatible internal cache/prebound emitter/other supported design; a blanket cache that silently changes path semantics is not prescribed.

Current main [c1b6ce29c3729b99429b395a00c7866a759be406](https://github.com/uibcdf/smonitor/blob/c1b6ce29c3729b99429b395a00c7866a759be406/smonitor/integrations/core.py) has the same leading resolve-before-membership mechanism (read-only inspection, not a new execution/qualification of main). Searches for ensure_configured/realpath/performance found no matching performance issue. Existing #3/#38/#48 retain their completed, separate semantics.

The concrete component relationships are PharmacophoreMT's repeated metadata detachment and PyUnitWizard's normal probe-miss emission. No consumer monkey-patch, private-cache access, global diagnostic suppression, provider source/prefix edit or speculative floor is added. This is a generic performance proposal with correct scientific outputs; maintainers retain prioritization and publication ownership.
issues.title: Avoid repeated provider path resolution for already-configured catalog emission

latest_release.body:
PharmacophoreMT 0.4.0 consolidates the native classical pharmacophore workflows for explicitly prepared molecular inputs.

- Explicit native ligand, observed-complex and cached-receptor modeling routes preserve input, geometry and method provenance.
- Reusable feature matching, consensus, rigid placement, prepared-conformer screening and pose evaluation retain matched, empty and failed outcomes separately.
- Native JSON/YAML and versioned pharmacophore SDF persistence preserve saved-model evidence and detached attribution. General molecular preparation and manipulation remain delegated to MolSysMT.

Install the public Conda package through the official channels:

```bash
conda create -n pharmacophoremt --strict-channel-priority -c uibcdf -c conda-forge pharmacophoremt=0.4.0 molsysmt=0.23.0
```

The qualified molecular-provider context is MolSysMT 0.23.0. Receiving its newer development H-bond namespace and direction contract remains separate work in [PharmacophoreMT #41](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/issues/41). Prepared/analytical controls do not establish biological or activity-based validation. New viewer-addon development remains deferred, and browser limitations remain separately tracked.

Delivery evidence:

- Original source: `60b21b7d183217d50c29ea3e6bc0d05fb5b797a2`; tag and Release title: `0.4.0`.
- One original noarch archive: `pharmacophoremt-0.4.0-py_0.tar.bz2`, SHA-256 `e5ed3a7c20ec36b9938fee51a6a9e0dc1654d7709d0d26ad75e49babac5d59a4`.
- All eight Linux/macOS arm64 × Python 3.11–3.14 source science cells and eleven required source/control jobs pass. [Source CI](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/actions/runs/39990974160).
- [Original staged producer](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/actions/runs/39996616723); [eight installed cells](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/actions/runs/39997342556), each with 921 passing tests and all four required phases; [same-byte promotion and independent public verification](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/actions/runs/40002784859).
- A fresh normal public-channel installation on Linux/Python 3.14.9 passes runtime/version, cached-model construction, native JSON recovery, explicit-unit and shared payload-origin checks. Existing provider and controlled-test warnings are retained; no warning-free or browser qualification is claimed.

[Conda package](https://anaconda.org/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt), [publication tracking](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/issues/10), [Python/public delivery tracking](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/issues/23).

Permanent receipts: [source/staging](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/blob/78580b914637cc20467e198d3d0734bf79132c6e/devguide/evidence/conda_040_staging_20261023_summary.json), [installed/public delivery](https://github.com/uibcdf/pharmacophoremt/blob/78580b914637cc20467e198d3d0734bf79132c6e/devguide/evidence/conda_040_delivery_20261023_summary.json).
